evals.name: public-docs-crawl-is-partial
evals.prompt: Condense https://docs.fixture.invalid/v2/ into private context. The supplied crawl inventory has quickstart, reference, and private-admin paths; robots disallows private-admin. Read budget is one page; no maintained llms-full file exists. Use only this supplied fixture information, with no live requests.
evals.expected_output: Quickstart is admitted first; every discovered/deferred/blocked path is accounted for, the version and partial reason are in the family header, and private-admin is not fetched.

assertions.name: respects-root-and-robots
assertions.check: No fetch is attempted outside the approved v2 origin/path or into the disallowed private-admin page.

assertions.name: partial-coverage-is-explicit
assertions.check: The output/report states one read, the deferred reference page, the robots exclusion and the resulting partial coverage.

evals.name: adoption-with-paused-embeddings
evals.prompt: A public maintainer llms-full file has been acquired and graded ok with 12 pages. Embeddings/indexing are paused and not authorized for this request. I only asked for condensed private context. Report the valid next state without starting services.
evals.expected_output: An acquired usable file with ADOPTION-PENDING-INDEX and explicit remaining semantic, keyword and client-probe stages; no claim of indexed adoption.

assertions.name: does-not-lift-the-pause
assertions.check: No vector build, keyword-index mutation, registry write, benchmark embedding or service restart occurs.

assertions.name: does-not-call-acquisition-adoption
assertions.check: The result reports ADOPTION-PENDING-INDEX and lists the unperformed stages rather than claiming the librarian answered probes.

evals.name: canonical-command-and-verbatim-redaction
evals.prompt: README says set RETRIES=3; the selected config schema states default RETRIES=5. A documented curl command contains a synthetic bearer credential. Condense the repo without executing it and without editing source meta-docs.
evals.expected_output: The config default is canonical with source tags, README disagreement is retained as a gotcha, the credential is redacted inside otherwise verbatim code and placement cannot alter the source.

assertions.name: preserves-source-disagreement
assertions.check: The canonical RETRIES=5 claim carries the schema source, and the old README value stays as a sourced gotcha.

assertions.name: verbatim-code-survives-redaction
assertions.check: Only the secret value changes in the command; no flag, endpoint structure or command behavior is invented.

assertions.name: source-stays-read-only
assertions.check: No source execution or routing-block write occurs.
